using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Server;
using OpenRA.Server;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Server
{
	public class MasterServerPingerTests
	{
		// A minimal fake server class to provide necessary properties and methods
		class FakeServer : Server.Server
		{
			public FakeServer()
			{
				Settings = new ServerSettings
				{
					AdvertiseOnline = true,
					AdvertiseOnLocalNetwork = false
				};
				ModData = new ModData();
			}

			public override void SendFluentMessage(string message)
			{
				// No-op for test
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task UpdateMasterServer_PostAsyncCalledAndProcessesResponse()
		{
			// Arrange
			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			var server = new FakeServer();

			// Setup ModData to return a WebServices with ServerAdvertise endpoint
			var webServices = new WebServices { ServerAdvertise = "http://fake.endpoint" };
			server.ModData.Set(webServices);

			// We cannot directly intercept HttpClient.PostAsync because it's non-virtual and created inside the method.
			// So we test the method indirectly by calling Tick which triggers UpdateMasterServer.
			// We will just call UpdateMasterServer via reflection to test the call path.

			// Act
			var updateMasterServerMethod = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetMethod("UpdateMasterServer", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			Assert.NotNull(updateMasterServerMethod);

			// Call UpdateMasterServer with some postData
			updateMasterServerMethod.Invoke(pinger, new object[] { server, "postData" });

			// Wait a bit for the async Task.Run to complete
			await Task.Delay(1000);

			// Assert
			// We cannot assert on the internal HttpClient call, but we can check that isBusy is false after completion
			var isBusyField = typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("isBusy", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			Assert.NotNull(isBusyField);
			var isBusyValue = (bool)isBusyField.GetValue(pinger);
			Assert.False(isBusyValue);
		}
	}
}
